BiblicalUsage: The word is the tip, the extremity, the lobe of the ear. The blood of the ram of consecration was put upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot; and the same blood was put on the cleansed leper.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the blood on the ear, the hand, and the foot means the whole man is consecrated: hearing, doing, and walking.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
